_authority: This file is the ONE canonical hard-stop taxonomy. No other artifact may maintain a competing list. scripts/control-plane/lib/outcome-semantics.mjs reads HARD_SAFETY_STOP.identifiers from here.

TRANSPORT_RESUME.rule: Session or runtime slice exhaustion is transport state. It is NEVER a business or authority block and never consumes a Founder action.

HARD_SAFETY_STOP.founder_action: one actual decision only when no executor continuation exists

hard_stop_record.rule: A terminal BLOCKED result must name a canonical HARD_SAFETY_STOP identifier, list the registered recovery paths actually attempted, and state why recovery cannot continue. A BLOCKED result while any recovery_attempts entry is not exhausted is invalid.

checkpoint_record.rule: A transport pause preserves a machine-readable checkpoint. platform_auto_resume must state honestly whether a real platform-native automatic resume mechanism exists; a false value is preserved as an architectural limitation, never disguised as a solved capability.

invariant: Every condition outside HARD_SAFETY_STOP has founder_action none.
recovery_before_block_invariant: A hard blocked result is illegal while a canonical safe recovery path remains unexhausted.
